svg.title: An Image and a Question in One Message
svg.desc: One user message holds two content parts: input_text with the question, for example what is in this image in three bullet points, and input_image with an image_url that is either a public URL or a base64 data URL. A vision-capable model reads both and the answer is read from output_text. Image options: use a public URL when the image is internet-reachable; a base64 data URL for private or uploaded images; and in Chat Completions, an image_url part with detail high reads fine print but uses more tokens.
svg.text: An Image and a Question in One Message
The image is the photo, the text part is the sticky note; a vision-capable model answers.
The question: "What is in this image? 3 bullet points."
image_url: a public URL or a base64 data URL
